expected_value_creation: Make route recommendations, execution, authority, evidence, outcomes, and governance reproducible without treating escalation as quality.
beneficiary: QIF evaluators, accountable reviewers, domain specialists, and affected stakeholders
supporting_evidence: v0.6.34 threshold replay shows decisions can flip near reviewed boundaries
Current AI evaluation practice emphasizes calibrated human oversight and claim boundaries
success_criteria: Route selection is deterministic from explicit rules
Actual route, authority, execution evidence, and route-specific outcome class are traceable
Mismatch, unresolved authority, failed escalation, unverified evidence, and insufficient data trigger governance
Counts and route volume are explicitly non-quality evidence
